question: Who among the following is the only Indian to have won an individual gold medal at the Olympics?(As of 2020)
solution:
The correct answer is **__Abhinav Bindra.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Abhinav Bindra clinched India's first and only individual Olympic gold medal in 2008**.
 
• The 2008 Olympics were held in Beijing (China).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Olympic Games are held in a time period of four years.
 
• The Olympic games were started in** Athens, Greece in 1896.**
 
• The 2020 Olympics games were scheduled to be organized in Tokyo (Japan), but the games got postponed due to COVID-19.
 
• The Olympic flag has a** white background, with five interconnected rings in the center.**
 
• **The rings are of Five colors: blue, yellow, black, green, and red.**
 
• These rings are symbolic and represent the** five continents of the world.**
